en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on the Determination of Formless States (Arūpadhammavavatthānavagga), 10. The Question of Dīghaṭṭhi "Venerable sir, is it possible to point out formless states as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out material form as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out material form, yet impossible to point out formless states? "Great king, material form is gross, while formless states are subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out material form, yet impossible to point out formless states. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the eye-faculty as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the eye-consciousness-element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the eye-faculty, yet impossible to point out the eye-consciousness-element? "Great king, the eye-faculty is gross, while the eye-consciousness-element is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the eye-faculty, yet impossible to point out the eye-consciousness-element. [The same exchange is repeated for the ear-faculty and ear-consciousness-element, the nose-faculty and nose-consciousness-element, the tongue-faculty and tongue-consciousness-element, the body-faculty and body-consciousness-element. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the mind-faculty as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the mind-consciousness-element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the mind-faculty, yet impossible to point out the mind-consciousness-element? "Great king, the mind-faculty is gross, while the mind-consciousness-element is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the mind-faculty, yet impossible to point out the mind-consciousness-element. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the earth element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the water element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the fire element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the air element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the space element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the consciousness element as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the space element, yet impossible to point out the consciousness element? "Great king, the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the space element are gross, while the consciousness element is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the space element, yet impossible to point out the consciousness element. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the past as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the future as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the present as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the present, yet impossible to point out the past or the future? "Great king, the present is gross, while the past and the future are subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the present, yet impossible to point out the past or the future. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the internal as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the external as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the internal and the external? "Great king, both the internal and the external are gross. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the internal and the external. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the conditioned as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the unconditioned as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the conditioned, yet impossible to point out the unconditioned? "Great king, the conditioned is gross, while the unconditioned is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the conditioned, yet impossible to point out the unconditioned. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the world as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the escape from the world as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the world, yet impossible to point out the escape from the world? "Great king, the world is gross, while the escape from the world is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the world, yet impossible to point out the escape from the world.

"But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out suffering as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the cessation of suffering as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out suffering, yet impossible to point out the cessation of suffering? "Great king, suffering is gross, while the cessation of suffering is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out suffering, yet impossible to point out the cessation of suffering. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the origin of suffering as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the path leading to the cessation of suffering as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the origin of suffering, yet impossible to point out the path leading to the cessation of suffering? "Great king, the origin of suffering is gross, while the path leading to the cessation of suffering is subtle. It is for this reason, great king, that it is possible to point out the origin of suffering, yet impossible to point out the path leading to the cessation of suffering. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out the aggregates as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is possible, great king. "But, venerable sir, is it possible to point out Nibbāna as being here, there, or anywhere at all? "It is not possible, great king. "Then, venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why it is possible to point out the aggregates, yet impossible to point out Nibbāna? "Great king, the aggregates are gross, while Nibbāna is subtle. ‘Bones may be as long as a hundred yojanas. But since there is not even a tree a hundred yojanas long, how then could there be bones as long as a hundred yojanas?”
“What do you think, Great King, have you heard that there are fish in the great ocean that are five hundred yojanas long?
“Yes, venerable sir, I have heard it.
“Surely, Great King, the bones of a fish five hundred yojanas long would themselves be hundreds of yojanas in length?”
Thus ends the tenth inquiry, that of Dīghaṭṭhi.
